judgments.reason: The paper's title and abstract explicitly introduce and describe the release of the multimodal dataset containing EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video for BCI paradigms, including the P300 speller.
judgments.paper_title: Dataset combining EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms

judgments.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS format, which is used by this dataset's BIDS version 1.9.0.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: The paper describes the EEG-BIDS standard, which is the data organization standard used by this dataset (BIDS Version 1.9.0).
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
